test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that corrects the misspelt words in the given sentence.**

The anti-terorist squod is investgating this case.

options.text: The anti-terrorist squod is investigatng this case.
The anti-terrorrist squad is invstigating this case.
The anti-terroist squad is investegating this case.
The anti-terrorist squad is investigating this case.

solution: The correct answer is 'The anti-terrorist squad is investigating this case.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the given question the wrong spellings are** 'Anti-terorist, squod, investgating'.** • The correct spelling of them are- **'Anti-terrorist, squad, investigating'.** • Let's look at the meaning of them: • **Anti**-**terrorist**: acting against, opposing, or combating terrorists. (आतंकवादियों के खिलाफ कार्य करना, उनका विरोध करना या उनका मुकाबला करना) • **Squad**: a group of people who work as a team. (दल के रूप में किसी विशेष काम करने वालों का समूह; दस्‍ता) • **Investigating**: to try to find out all the facts about something. (तथ्‍यों के लिए किसी मामले की छानबीन करना, तहक़ीक़ात करना) • Thus, among the given Options only **Option 4 **has all the correct spellings. **Correct Sentence:__** *Te **anti-terrorist squad **is **investigating** this case.* 3b:Tcaf, The correct answer is '**were**'.
